title: Open Horizon Bob Mode Configuration
description: Configuration file schema for .bob/oh-config.json. Supports multiple Exchange profiles and remote node definitions.

activeProfile.description: Name of the profile to use when no environment variables are set.

profiles.description: Named Exchange environment profiles. Each key is a profile name (e.g. 'local', 'staging', 'production').

remoteNodes.description: Named remote edge node definitions for SSH-based operations.

Profile.description: An Exchange connection profile. Credentials may be inlined or referenced via 'env:VAR' syntax.

HZN_EXCHANGE_USER_AUTH.description: Credentials as 'username:password', 'username:apikey', or 'env:VAR_NAME' to read from environment variable.

HZN_FSS_CSSURL.description: CSS server URL for model management (optional).

extends.description: Name of a base profile to inherit from. Fields in this profile override the base.

RemoteNode.description: SSH-accessible remote edge node for remote agent inspection and debugging.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote node.

sshUser.description: SSH username with passwordless sudo access.

sshKeyPath.description: Path to SSH private key file (default: ~/.ssh/id_rsa).

agentType.description: 'native' for systemd-managed agent, 'container' for podman/docker container agent.

configPath.description: Path to agent config file on remote node (e.g. /etc/default/horizon).
